title: Autonomous Questioning Structural Intelligence (AQSI): Question Discovery, Multi-Granularity Influence Scoring, Structural Relay, and Research Governance
description: AQSI is a theory-first research framework for autonomous discovery, representation, evaluation, and exploration of research questions. It proposes multi-granularity directional influence scoring, historical question intelligence and differential trees, canonical Question Units and exploration contracts, strategic question control planes, UTN-supported cross-domain question transfer, and evidence-aware structural relay for collective learning. This v1.0.0 release presents research hypotheses, conceptual specifications, illustrative cases, and a validation roadmap; it does not claim an implemented runtime, demonstrated performance gains, verified recursive self-improvement, or artificial superintelligence.
